name: External Rewrites
description: Per-rule exclusion + 301 engine for archival CPT posts whose canonical home has moved off WordPress. Each rule targets every post in a (post type × taxonomy × term) intersection and can hide them from Yoast XML sitemaps, 301 single posts to a chosen destination, 301 the term archive, or hide the term itself from the sitemap.

settings.label: Rewrite rules
settings.description: Each row targets one (post type × taxonomy × term) intersection. The module is a no-op until at least one rule is added. Yoast sitemap features only apply when Yoast SEO is active.
